description: Tool to update an existing one-on-one event type (kind: solo) in Calendly. Use when you need to modify event type settings such as name, duration, location, or description. NOTE: Currently only supports one-on-one event types.

inputSchema.description: Request model for updating an existing event type.

active.description: Indicates if the event type is active and available for booking
active.title: Active

color.description: Hexadecimal color value for the scheduling page. Must match pattern ^#[a-f\d]{6}$ (e.g., '#fff200')
color.title: Color

description.description: The event type description that will be shown on the scheduling page (plain text format)
examples: A quick 15 minute meeting to discuss your needs
description.title: Description

duration.description: Length of sessions in minutes. Must be between 1 and 720 minutes. Should be one of the duration_options if both are provided.
duration.title: Duration

duration_options.description: Alternative duration choices for flexible meetings. Maximum 4 unique values allowed. Each must be between 1 and 720 minutes.
duration_options.title: Duration Options

locale.description: Locale for the event type's scheduling page language
locale.title: Locale

locations.description: Configuration information for each possible location where the event can take place

items.description: Location configuration for the event type.

additional_info.description: Additional location information or instructions for invitees
additional_info.title: Additional Info

kind.description: Type of location for the event. Common values: 'zoom_conference', 'google_meet', 'microsoft_teams', 'physical', 'ask_invitee', 'outbound_call', 'inbound_call', 'custom'
kind.title: Kind

location.description: Location address or description (required when kind is 'physical' or 'custom')
location.title: Location

phone_number.description: Phone number for phone call locations (required when kind is 'outbound_call' or 'inbound_call')
phone_number.title: Phone Number

items.title: LocationConfig

locations.title: Locations

name.description: The event type name that will be displayed to invitees
name.title: Name

uuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the event type to update. Can be provided as either the full event type URI (e.g., 'https://api.calendly.com/event_types/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA') or just the UUID portion (e.g., 'AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA'). Supports both alphanumeric format (e.g., 'GBGBDCAADAEDCRZ2') and standard UUID format (e.g., 'cdeba4c3-5adb-477d-8972-7317836eb40d'). Use LIST_USER_S_EVENT_TYPES action to retrieve valid event type URIs.
uuid.title: Uuid

inputSchema.title: UpdateEventTypeRequest

name: update_event_type

CustomQuestion.description: Custom question configuration for the event type.

answer_choices.description: Available answer options for multiple-choice questions
answer_choices.title: Answer Choices

enabled.description: Whether the question is currently enabled and shown to invitees
enabled.title: Enabled

include_other.description: Whether to include an 'Other' option allowing custom text input
include_other.title: Include Other

name.description: The question text displayed to invitees during booking
name.title: Name

position.description: Display order of the question in the booking form
position.title: Position

required.description: Whether the invitee must answer this question to complete booking
required.title: Required

CustomQuestion.title: CustomQuestion

ProfileInfo.description: Profile information of the event type owner.

owner.description: URI of the owning user resource
owner.title: Owner

ProfileInfo.title: ProfileInfo

UpdateEventTypeResponse.description: Response model containing the updated event type details.

active.description: Whether the event type is active and available for booking
active.title: Active

booking_method.description: The booking method for the event type
booking_method.title: Booking Method

created_at.description: Timestamp when event type was created (ISO 8601 format)
created_at.title: Created At

custom_questions.description: Custom questions asked to invitees during the booking process
custom_questions.title: Custom Questions

duration_options.description: Available duration options for flexible meetings
duration_options.title: Duration Options

internal_note.description: Internal notes for the event type
internal_note.title: Internal Note

profile.description: Profile information of the event type owner
profile.title: Profile

scheduling_url.description: Public scheduling page URL where invitees can book
scheduling_url.title: Scheduling Url

slug.description: URL-friendly identifier for the event type
slug.title: Slug

updated_at.description: Timestamp when event type was last updated (ISO 8601 format)
updated_at.title: Updated At

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the event type
uri.title: Uri
